Name: THE BOYZ Lightstick Sword
Author: youngwon1
Description:
THE BOYZ Lightstick Sword
A fan-made THE BOYZ lightstick-inspired weapon mod for Stardew Valley!
Transform your weapon into a pixel-art version of the iconic heart-shaped lightstick, featuring a white heart, red accents, and a long black handle.
Features
[list]
[*]Custom pixel-art weapon sprite.[/*]
[*]Heart-shaped white lightstick design.[/*]
[*]Red detail in the heart and a thin red handle band.[/*]
[*]Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6.15.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Json Assets[/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Json Assets.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Notes
This is an unofficial fan-made mod and is not affiliated with THE BOYZ or their official management.
